caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a vintage Bunsen burner placed on a flat surface. The burner consists of a cylindrical vertical metal tube mounted on a round, flat base. The base appears circular, textured, and slightly mottled, suggesting a weathered metal surface. Attached to the base, there is a small circular ring or cap resting off to the side, separate from the main structure. The vertical tube has an adjustable slider positioned in a slot, likely for controlling the airflow. About halfway up the main vertical tube, there is a flat, circular collar. At the top, there is a wider cylindrical chamber with a slightly flared, rounded edge, and a central opening, all rendered in a gray monochromatic scale. The background is a uniform light beige color, with no other elements present. A small signature is visible in the bottom left corner.
title: Candlestick/Whale Oil Lamp
